subject.title: [Feature]: Add a standard AISP/AISOP proposal contract for Skill Workshop

question: Should OpenClaw standardize a Skill Workshop lifecycle contract in core, and if so should it be AISP/AISOP, OpenClaw-native, or external/ClawHub reference material?
rationale: The current runtime already enforces many invariants, but choosing a machine-readable contract format and authority affects product/security ownership and whether the artifact becomes part of OpenClaw core.

options.title: Core OpenClaw-native contract
options.body: Add a docs/tests-owned OpenClaw-native contract or fixture that mirrors current Skill Workshop invariants without AISP runtime dependency.

options.title: AISP/AISOP reference artifact
options.body: Accept an optional AISP/AISOP package as illustrative reference material while making clear it is not runtime policy.

options.title: Keep outside core
options.body: Route AISP/AISOP packaging to ClawHub or an external repo and keep core focused on docs and tests for its own service invariants.

recommendation.title: Core OpenClaw-native contract
recommendation.body: Add a docs/tests-owned OpenClaw-native contract or fixture that mirrors current Skill Workshop invariants without AISP runtime dependency.

likelyOwner.reason: This person introduced the core Skill Workshop service and proposal lifecycle surfaces that the contract would describe.
